answer: Each identity locks an 80 bond and registers one river vault at an anchor point, key-sealed. Each epoch at dawn it files site, weight, date. The falcon auditor recomputes the sediment load from the river gauge table; a reused seal, wrong weight, or mismatched dawn record burns the bond. Same-source identities pay: the kth pays 36+7(k-1), so the 1,000th pays 7,029 and 1,000 fakes pay 3,532,500 plus 80,000 locked bonds. A rented vault fails the falcon check: it bears another seal and weight. An honest identity pays 36 plus an 80 bond for its anchor vault, returned after an epoch.
